_comment: Copy to backend/mcp_servers.json and set MCP_ENABLED=true (or mcp_enabled
in .env) to load these at startup. Every tool a server lists is registered
as mcp__<server>__<tool>, bound to the Integrations Bench station, and
called through the same tool_registry as the built-in tools.
grant_to names the agents allowed to call that server's tools. Omit it and
every specialist gets them; the boss never does, because it plans rather
